[[Sayaka Senbongi]] |enva2=Michelle Ruff }} The '''Thievul trio''' are a trio of {{p|Thievul}} that roam around [[Wyndon]]. They are friends with [[Goh's Cinderace]]. ==In animation== [[File:Goh Cinderace and Thievul.png|thumb|left|250px|Thievul and Cinderace]] The Thievul trio first appeared in ''[[JN004|Settling the Scorbunny!]]'' when they were all {{p|Nickit}}. With the help of a {{TP|Goh|Scorbunny}}, they would steal scones from a Wyndon shop, before being stopped by {{Ash}} and [[Goh]]. They later encouraged Scorbunny to go with Goh after it befriended the boy. They briefly reappeared in a flashback in ''[[JN022|Goodbye, Friend!]]''. In ''[[JN127|Just a Scone's Throw From Here!]]'', they stopped a group of Galarian {{p|Zigzagoon}} from stealing a lady's food and returned it to her. They were united with Scorbunny who had since evolved into {{p|Cinderace}}. During their reunion, the Zigzagoon returned asking them for help after they'd been attacked by a {{p|Perrserker}} and two Galarian {{p|Meowth}}. Following the Zigzagoon, they were captured by {{TRT}} who were working with the Perrserker and Meowth. After being freed by Cinderace, they joined in the battle against Team Rocket and battled against the Perrserker and Meowth. During the battle, they evolved into Thievul where they were able to defeat them before sending Team Rocket blasting off. ===Personality and characteristics=== When they were first seen, the Thievul trio were shown to be mischievous, stealing food with the help of {{TP|Goh|Scorbunny}}. After seeing how Scorbunny had befriended Goh, they convinced Scorbunny to leave them showing how much they cared for it. Afterwards, they worked to help people and Pokémon in [[Wyndon]], as seen in ''[[JN127|Just a Scone's Throw From Here!]]'' when they stopped a group of Galarian {{p|Zigzagoon}} from stealing a lady's bag of food. After they were rewarded with scones, they showed no bad feelings towards the Zigzagoon and shared their food with them.
